items.title: GlobalFoundries’s journey to building a FinOps operating model on AWS
items.summary: GlobalFoundries built a FinOps operating model on AWS native tools to gain unit-cost visibility, cut waste, maximize Savings Plans coverage, catch anomalies early, and give engineers self-service cost estimates. The results include a 9% reduction in EC2 unit cost, compute utilization rising from 60% to 91%, Savings Plans utilization reaching 100%, and cost estimates that take 15 minutes instead of four hours.
items.creator: Aaron Dunteman
